description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止请求重复提交。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.
The ID of the instance whose configuration you want to change.

description.zh:
变配类型，取值
- Upgrade：升级。
- Downgrade：降级。
description.en:
The type of configuration change. Valid values:

- Upgrade

- Downgrade
The list of parameters. You can specify up to 100 parameters.

description.zh:
第n个模块属性code配置，n的取值范围为（1~100），如有多个模块属性参数，按照n=1,2,3…n的形式拼接多个参数。

> 只设置需要变更配置的模块属性信息，如A,B两个属性中，只有A需要变更配置，则只传A属性相关即可。
description.en:
The code of the module property.

> Specify only the module properties that you want to change. For example, if you have two properties, A and B, and you only want to change property A, pass only the information related to property A.

description.zh: 第n个模块属性value配置，n的取值范围为（1~100）。
description.en: The value of the module property.

description.zh:
付费类型，取值：
- Subscription：预付费。
- PayAsYouGo：后付费。
description.en:
The billing method. Valid values:

- Subscription: subscription.

- PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go.
